items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Fran plays piano too... See, that's what I tell him first about playing.

ctx.x: You had Steve. You had Walter Deco. All of them was leading around you at that time on piano for jazz. They all was leading. Fran plays piano too. That's right. Yeah. But Fran just mostly chords. He just chords. He never could pick up a melody. See, that's what I tell him first about playing. Well, how I learned how to pick up a melody and play variation along with it, I used to play a three piece job.
